title: Spreads and puck lines shown with no explanation of which side/why
steps: Read NHL slate: "Vancouver Canucks +1.5 -169 ... No edge"
expected: Label "Best price on any side" or explain the side shown
actual: Casual user sees a pick-like line with "No edge" and does not know why it is shown; "+1.5" and "ML" unexplained; heavy price (-476, -909) shown without noting you risk far more than you win.
